statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (A : Set (GP.Space m)) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s), let d : ℝ≥0 := ⟨s, hs.le⟩; (d : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal s ∧ (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal s → MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure s A = 0) ∧ (ENNReal.ofReal s < dimH A → MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure s A = ⊤) ∧ (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure s A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) ∧ (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure s A = ⊤ → ENNReal.ofReal s ≤ dimH A)
proof:
intro m A s hs d
have hd : (d : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal s :=
  ENNReal.coe_nnreal_eq d
refine ⟨hd, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro h
  exact hausdorffMeasure_of_dimH_lt (d := d) (hd.symm ▸ h)
· intro h
  exact hausdorffMeasure_of_lt_dimH (d := d) (hd.symm ▸ h)
· intro h
  rw [← hd]
  apply dimH_le_of_hausdorffMeasure_ne_top (d := d)
  change MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure s A ≠ ⊤
  rw [h]
  exact zero_ne_top
· intro h
  rw [← hd]
  exact le_dimH_of_hausdorffMeasure_eq_top (d := d) h
